hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -d "$d/scripts" ] || d=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); t=$(jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); "$d"/scripts/context-budget.sh register --runtime claude ${t:+--transcript "$t"} || true
d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -d "$d/scripts" ] || d=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); h="$d/scripts/hooks/context-budget-claude-hook.sh"; [ -x "$h" ] || exit 0; exec "$h"

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -d "$d/scripts" ] || d=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); t=$(jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); "$d"/scripts/context-budget.sh release --runtime claude ${t:+--transcript "$t"} --quiet || true
d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -d "$d/scripts" ] || d=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); h="$d/scripts/hooks/context-budget-stop-hook.sh"; [ -x "$h" ] || exit 0; exec "$h" claude
